headline: Mason Wells Acquires Canworks with Mesirow Advising
summary: Canworks, Inc., a digital printer for the beverage industry, was acquired by Mason Wells, with Mesirow acting as exclusive financial advisor.
why: Mesirow is an independent financial services firm providing investment banking, wealth management, and capital markets advisory services.

impacts.name: Canworks
impacts.why: Corporate acquisition transfers ownership control of the target company to the private equity buyer.
